question: Will there be an armed conflict in the Falkland Islands before January 1, 2027?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if credible reports from established news organizations confirm that an armed conflict — defined as organized military or paramilitary hostilities — has begun in or around the Falkland Islands (Islas Malvinas) at any point before January 1, 2027 (UTC).
- "No": Wins if no such armed conflict has been credibly confirmed to have begun in or around the Falkland Islands (Islas Malvinas) before January 1, 2027 (UTC).

Clarifications:
- "Armed conflict" requires organized military or paramilitary hostilities involving at least one state actor; isolated incidents, diplomatic disputes, protests, or economic measures do not qualify.
- The conflict must have physically occurred in or directly involving the Falkland Islands territory or its surrounding waters; remote political declarations or threats alone do not qualify.

data_sources: ACLED (Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project)
